comprehensive-fix-plan.title: Critical CRUD Operations Schema Fix for All Reference Modules

problem-analysis.summary: All reference modules (financial_centers, cost_centers, articles, nomenclatures) have critical schema mismatches that prevent users from creating reference data. The endpoints attempt to access and set database fields (created_by, managed_by) that don't exist in the actual SQLAlchemy models.

affected-functionality.item: Financial Centers creation (500 Internal Server Error)
Cost Centers creation (500 Internal Server Error)
All settings pages (/settings/*) non-functional for CRUD operations

impact.user-impact: Users cannot create any reference data, making the application unusable for budget setup and configuration.

root-cause.description: Endpoints were written assuming created_by and managed_by fields exist in database models, but actual SQLAlchemy models only contain: id, code, name, description, is_active, user_id, created_at, updated_at.

solution-strategy.approach: Remove all references to non-existent created_by and managed_by fields from endpoints while maintaining data integrity and user isolation through existing user_id field.

principles.principle: Maintain strict user data isolation via user_id
Use only fields that exist in database models
